does: Runs, once a server tick, the combat AI's current decision request: for the character at the head of the request queue it prepares the AI helpers, asks the camera to follow it (eoc::ai::combat::RequestCameraMoveComponent), times the calculation, runs a step of it and, when the calculation is complete, finishes it and unprepares.

evidence.says: PrepareRequest, then ecs::AddComponent<eoc::ai::combat::RequestCameraMoveComponent>, ls::TimeDelta stamps at +0x1A8/+0x1B8 of the AI data, the step at code:unplaced::StepCombatAiCalculation, the state byte +0x208 equal to 0x14 leading to code:unplaced::FinishCombatAiCalculation, then UnprepareRequest

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called every server tick from 1 place, while the PrepareRequest it calls ran only in the fight segments where an enemy took its turn (21, 36, 38, 39, 41 to 44), 308 times

questions.ask: A probe in a fight that reads the head of the request queue at each call, in an enemy's turn and outside one, would show what it does with a request.
